name: A Sound Effect
holds: A marketplace of sound effect libraries from independent makers, with a free section.
notes: Paid libraries are perpetual, per workstation, and must sit inside a larger production. AI training is barred. Free libraries use a separate one-user free EULA: https://www.asoundeffect.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/free_eula22.pdf The link is the store's plain address and carries no affiliate or referral code.
